responsibility: Exports the user-facing intrinsic header for PowerPC paired-single operations, primarily for 750CL-style targets. It defines an 8-byte vector type alias, maps paired arithmetic, fused multiply-add/subtract, merge, load/store, reciprocal, sqrt, select, and compare operations onto rs6000 __builtin_paired_* entry points, and provides named condition-code wrappers for compare predicates, serving as the C interface layer above the backend paired-single builtin implementations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike paired.md, this is the public C header for paired-single support: it exposes vector aliases, intrinsic-style macros, and compare wrapper names that map user code onto rs6000 paired builtins, rather than defining RTL instruction patterns or lowering rules.
